title: Query trace determined by available coordinates
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\Omega$ be a set of coordinate values, and let $\alpha$ be a set of leaf labels. A finite decision tree queries coordinates from its available set, branching according to observed values. If two inputs $x,y$ agree at every coordinate in that available set, then the tree has the same query trace on $x$ and $y$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a finite decision tree over $\Omega$ with leaf labels in $\alpha$ and available coordinates $A$
$x,y$ assign values in $\Omega$ to each of the $n$ coordinates
